source: World of Warcraft: Forever beta client, build 1.60.1.70753: per-rank tooltips (level 60, no gear), rank caps and positions from talentsforever.com's data export (generated 2026-11-03, CC BY 4.0); positions and prerequisite arrows cross-checked against thewowdb.com's Trait-table snapshot of build 1.60.1.70532; talent ids, Classic status/diff/tooltips and removed-Classic-talent lists from warcraftforever.games (beta client 1.60.1.70205, captured 2026-10-04). removed_since_demo.name: Improved Shifting Power

removed_since_demo.name: Berserk
removed_since_demo.rank1:
Requires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form.
Causes your Primal Bite ability to strike up to 3 targets, removes its cooldown, and increases the critical strike chance of your Combo Point-generating abilities by 100%. Clears and grants immunity to Fear effects for the duration. Lasts 15 sec.

Restoration: the Trait-edge snapshot disagrees with the talentsforever export (only in the snapshot: Furor, Gift of the Earthmother; only in the export: Bloom, Heart of the Wild; moved or re-capped: Reflection, Subtlety); the export's positions, rank caps and prerequisites used for this tree

talents.name: Moonkin Form
ranks:
Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by 100%, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and all party or raid members within 45 yards have their Critical Strike chance increased by 3%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and prevents the use of healing spells.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
classic:
Transforms the Druid into Moonkin Form. While in this form the armor contribution from items is increased by 360% and all party members within 0 yards have their spell critical chance increased by 3%. The Moonkin can only cast Balance spells while shapeshifted.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
